notes.title: Bug Fixes and Game Adjustment
notes.notes:
We have fixed:
[olist] 
[*] Story events triggering error after activities 
[*] Sound anomalies during some story events
[*] Mouse pointer issue when entering the main game from the title screen 
[/olist] 
We have adjusted: 
[olist] 
[*] Slightly increased reaction time for the email fraud minigame 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Language Autoload
notes.notes: We have made an urgent update where the game's language will now automatically load from Steam upon the first launch. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
